info.title: EximPe Payment Gateway API — v3 Orders
info.description: Create Order, Get Order Details and Get Order Status for the v3 API. v3 supports three collection modes: Hosted Checkout, S2S UPI Intent and S2S UPI Collect.

Hosted Checkout.description: Buyer completes payment on the EximPe-hosted page.

get.description: Retrieve only an order's status. Use it for lightweight polling.

parameters.name: order_id
parameters.description: The order's ID, from Create Order.

404.description: No order with this ID belongs to you

details.error: An unexpected error occurred. Please try again later

clientAuth.name: X-Client-ID
clientAuth.description: **Client Application ID** - Your unique application identifier used to authenticate API requests. You can find your Client ID in the Developer Settings section of the merchant dashboard.

clientSecretAuth.name: X-Client-Secret
clientSecretAuth.description: **Client Secret Key** - Your secret key used alongside the Client ID for secure authentication. Keep this confidential and never expose it in client-side code. Available in the Developer Settings section of the merchant dashboard.

merchantAuth.name: X-Merchant-ID
merchantAuth.description: **Sub-merchant ID** - Send this only when you authenticate as a PSP and create the order for one of your sub-merchants: it names that sub-merchant. A PSP that leaves it out is refused with a `401`. Merchants that authenticate with their own Client ID and Client Secret do not send it.

phone.description: Phone number in E.164 format: `+`, the country code, then the number (e.g. `+919812345678`)

ip_address.description: The customer's IP address. Required for S2S UPI Intent and S2S UPI Collect; ignored for Hosted Checkout

user_agent.description: The customer's browser user agent. Required for S2S UPI Intent and S2S UPI Collect; ignored for Hosted Checkout

amount.description: Amount in rupees, as a decimal string such as `"1000.00"`. A JSON number is also accepted. More than two decimal places are rounded to two, so `1000.456` is charged as `1000.46`. Must be greater than 0 and at most 10,000,000.00.

currency.description: ISO 4217 currency code. Hosted Checkout and S2S UPI collect in INR only.

reference_id.description: Your reference for the order: letters, numbers and hyphens only. Must be unique across your orders, including failed ones.

return_url.description: Optional. Where Hosted Checkout sends the customer when the payment finishes. Without it the customer sees EximPe's own result page. S2S UPI Intent and Collect do not redirect the customer.

collection_mode.description: Mode of payment collection. Required — there is no server-side default.

mop_type.description: Hosted Checkout: optional, limits the payment page to one payment method. `card` lets the buyer pay by credit or debit card, and needs card payments enabled on your account. S2S UPI Intent and Collect: required, must be `upi`.

upi_flow_type.description: Required for S2S: `intent` for S2S UPI Intent, `collection` for S2S UPI Collect. Not case-sensitive; `collect` is refused. Not used by Hosted Checkout.

vpa.description: S2S UPI Collect only, where it is required: the customer's UPI ID, which receives the payment request. Lowercased before the pattern is checked. Ignored by the other flows.

upi_expiry_minutes.description: S2S UPI Intent and Collect: how long the customer has to complete the payment, in minutes. Omitted or null means 5. Some payment methods allow less than you ask for, so read the window that applies from `expires_at`. Ignored by Hosted Checkout.

business_model.description: Whether the buyer is a business (B2B) or a consumer (B2C). Optional — derived from the merchant's KYC when omitted.

purpose_code.description: FEMA/FETERS purpose code this order settles under (e.g. S0802). Optional — derived from the merchant's allowed purpose codes when omitted and exactly one is allowed.

buyer.description: The buyer paying for this order. `name`, `email`, `phone` and `address` (including `postal_code`) are required.

success.description: Indicates if the request was successful

details.description: What failed. Usually an object keyed by field and nested like the request, one message per field. A purpose-code refusal is a plain string.

success.description: Indicates if the request was successful. Always false for error responses.

number.description: Invoice number. Letters, numbers, spaces and `. , ' - / & _ ( ) : ; ! @ # $ % * + = < > [ ] { } | ~`. Must be unique across your orders that have not failed.

session_id.description: Hosted Checkout only. 64-character hex string you pass to the EximPe JS SDK. Valid for 15 minutes.

intent_uri.description: S2S UPI Intent only. The UPI payment request. It may or may not start with `upi://pay?` — see the Create Order page for how to invoke it.

test_simulator_url.description: Sandbox only. Open in a browser to complete an S2S UPI payment without a real UPI app. Not returned in production.

expires_at.description: S2S UPI Intent and Collect. When the request stops accepting payment, in UTC: `upi_expiry_minutes` after creation (5 if not sent), or sooner if the payment method allows less. Take the outcome from the webhook or the Order Status API, not from this time.

message.description: S2S UPI Collect only. Always `UPI Collection request sent`: the request reached the customer's UPI app. It does not mean the customer has paid.

order_id.description: The order's ID: `OD` followed by 10 digits.

reference_id.description: Unique reference identifier for the order

opted_mop_type.description: The method of payment chosen when the order was created, in lowercase. `null` when none was chosen.

phone.description: Buyer's phone number with country code

address.description: The buyer's address. `null` when the order has no `line_1`, even if other address fields were sent.

buyer.description: The buyer. `null` when the order holds no buyer name.

product.description: What is being sold. `null` when the order has no product name.

delivery_due_date.description: Due date of delivery, in YYYY-MM-DD format

invoice.description: Invoice details. `null` when the order has no invoice number, date, delivery due date or file.

business_model.description: Whether the buyer is a business or a consumer. `null` until it is known: the order did not declare one and your KYC does not name exactly one.

purpose_code.description: FEMA/FETERS purpose code the order settles under (e.g. `S0802`), or `null` until it is known.

hs_code.description: Harmonized System code, required for physical goods

mop_type.description: The method of payment used, in lowercase. `null` when none was chosen.

status.description: Payment status. `invalid`: the attempt was voided when its order failed.

linked_primary_payment_id.description: For a top-up counted toward an earlier payment, that payment's `payment_id`; `status` and `message` are then read from it. Otherwise `null`.

success.description: Indicates if the request was successful

status.description: `payment_pending`: no payment has gone through yet. `payment_successful`: a payment was captured. `failed`: the order failed or was abandoned.

status_message.description: Why the order is in its status, when there is a reason to give.

created_at.description: When the order was created. UTC, e.g. `2026-10-15T06:44:13.414209Z`.

last_updated_at.description: When the order last changed. UTC, e.g. `2026-10-15T06:44:13.414209Z`.

ApiVersion.name: X-API-Version
ApiVersion.description: Optional. Send `3.0.0`. It is not a credential. The response's `X-API-Version` header echoes the value you sent, or your account's default version if you send none.
